committee.name: Investment Director
committee.mandate: Coordinate the committee, resolve contradictions, enforce evidence standards, and issue the final living investment memo.

committee.name: Business Analyst
committee.mandate: Evaluate business quality, market structure, moat, management, unit economics, reinvestment runway, and competitive durability.

committee.name: Valuation Analyst
committee.mandate: Estimate value using multiple independent methods and express uncertainty through bear/base/bull scenarios.

committee.name: Bear / Red Team
committee.mandate: Attempt to falsify the thesis, identify missing evidence, hidden dependencies, governance risks, and ways permanent capital loss can occur.

committee.name: Market & Catalyst Analyst
committee.mandate: Track earnings, filings, macro conditions, catalysts, positioning, and timing-sensitive developments without overriding long-horizon fundamentals.

committee.name: Portfolio & Risk Agent
committee.mandate: Determine whether the asset improves the portfolio after concentration, correlation, liquidity, downside, and opportunity-cost analysis.

committee.name: Long-Horizon Scout
committee.mandate: Search the investable universe for 5-15 year asymmetric opportunities that can beat the current portfolio hurdle rate and current watchlist leader.

committee.name: Monitor
committee.mandate: Continuously compare new filings, prices, news, operating metrics, and material events against each living thesis.
